## Highlights

Steno 0.14 makes incremental builds aware of the inputs each page uses, rebuilds affected pages
during development, and makes errors easier to diagnose without giving up atomic output.

## Themes and templates

- Cached pages now track the layouts, components, includes, data, and collection values they use,
  so changes invalidate the affected output rather than leaving stale pages behind
  ([#315](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/315), [#316](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/316)).
- Rendering errors identify the source page, active theme, and configuration where available.
  Tau error codes and recovery hints remain available through Steno's error context
  ([#312](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/312)).

## Development and scaffolding

- `steno dev` forwards changed file paths to the build pipeline and rebuilds only pages affected
  by tracked dependencies. Inputs that cannot be tracked safely retain conservative invalidation
  ([#316](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/316)).
- Configuration, plugin loading, and plugin lifecycle failures now provide more specific context
  and recovery guidance ([#312](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/312)).
- `@steno/init` and the official themes now target the 0.14 package set.

## Packages and API stability

- Steno 0.14 uses `@steno/core@0.2.0`, including theme dependency metadata and improved diagnostics.
  Existing compatibility exports remain available
  ([#312](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/312), [#315](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/315)).
- Page dependency snapshots are retained in the persistent build cache. Legacy cache entries are
  rendered again when dependency information is missing
  ([#315](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/315)).

## Release confidence

- Added regression coverage for indirect dependency edits, rapid changes, cache reuse, and
  selective rebuild behavior ([#317](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/317)).
- Added incremental-build benchmarks and budgets alongside the existing full-build and rendering
  checks. Shared dependency fingerprints are reused within each build
  ([#315](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/315), [#317](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/317)).
- Removed redundant tests while preserving package-owned coverage
  ([#313](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/313)).

## Dependencies

- Updated the first-party release graph to Steno, init, and official themes 0.14.0, with Core 0.2.0.
  Tau remains at 0.9.0 and `marked` remains at 18.0.11.
